shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣举着一只双表减压阀
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a two gauge gas pressure regulator, smiling at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课：减压阀、管路与阀门。

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣指向气瓶到仪器的一条气路
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points along a gas line running from a chained cylinder to an instrument.
shots.narration: 气从瓶里出来，要过好几道关。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一只减压阀往气瓶上拧，拧不进
shots.prompt_en: The young male student tries to screw a regulator onto a cylinder valve but it will not fit.
shots.narration: 阿杰的减压阀，怎么也拧不进去。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 他拿出转接头和钳子
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pulls out an adapter and a pair of pliers from a drawer.
shots.narration: 他想找个转接头，再拿钳子使劲。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 老李按住他的手
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer puts a hand on his shoulder and shakes his head.
shots.narration: 老李：拧不进，就说明接错了！

shots.section_title: 减压阀：把高压降到稳定可用
shots.scene: 减压阀剖面：高压进、低压出
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a regulator cross section with high pressure gas entering and low pressure gas leaving, arrows. No text.
shots.narration: 减压阀把瓶内高压降下来。
overlay: 减压阀：把高压降到稳定可用

shots.section_title: 减压阀：把高压降到稳定可用
shots.scene: 两块压力表分别高亮
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a regulator with two gauges, the inlet gauge and the outlet gauge highlighted one after the other, dials without numbers. No text.
shots.narration: 一块看瓶内压力，一块看输出压力。

shots.section_title: 减压阀：把高压降到稳定可用
shots.scene: 输出压力稳定的曲线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flat steady line on a chart while the cylinder pressure line slowly falls. No text.
shots.narration: 输出稳定，下游仪器才安全。

shots.section_title: 减压阀：把高压降到稳定可用
shots.scene: 背压阀守住上游，超压就放
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a back pressure valve on a line opening to release gas when upstream pressure rises. No text.
shots.narration: 背压阀守住上游，压力高了就放。

shots.section_title: 减压阀按气体专用，与气瓶配套
shots.scene: 减压阀上贴着气体标识
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: several regulators on a wall, each tagged with a blank gas label matching its cylinder. No text.
shots.narration: 减压阀按气体专用，不能混用。
overlay: 减压阀按气体专用，与气瓶配套

shots.section_title: 减压阀按气体专用，与气瓶配套
shots.scene: 氧气表装到可燃气瓶上，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an oxygen regulator being fitted onto a flammable gas cylinder, crossed out with a fire icon. No text.
shots.narration: 氧气表绝不能装到可燃气瓶上。

shots.section_title: 减压阀按气体专用，与气瓶配套
shots.scene: 减压阀和压力表与气瓶配套
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a matched regulator and gauge set on its own cylinder with a tick, the set moved to another cylinder crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 表和阀要配套，不拿去别的瓶用。

shots.section_title: 减压阀按气体专用，与气瓶配套
shots.scene: 按流量、口径和调节范围选型
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a regulator with a flow arrow, a pipe size icon and an adjustment range icon, the facility engineer checking. No text.
shots.narration: 按用气量和压力选型，专业人员确认。

shots.section_title: 减压阀按气体专用，与气瓶配套
shots.scene: 低温储罐用低温专用阀
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a frosty cryogenic tank valve with a snowflake icon, an ordinary valve crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 低温工况，用低温专用阀。

shots.section_title: 接口不匹配，绝不硬接、不用转接头
shots.scene: 不同气体的接头规格不同
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: several regulator inlet fittings of different shapes each matching only its own valve outlet. No text.
shots.narration: 接头规格不同，就是防止接错气。
overlay: 接口不匹配，绝不硬接、不用转接头

shots.section_title: 接口不匹配，绝不硬接、不用转接头
shots.scene: 转接头硬接打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an adapter between a mismatched regulator and a cylinder valve, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 绝不能用转接头硬接。

shots.section_title: 接口不匹配，绝不硬接、不用转接头
shots.scene: 拧不进就停手，查清原因
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand stopping on a regulator nut that will not thread in, a magnifier and a question mark. No text.
shots.narration: 拧不进就停手，先查清楚。

shots.section_title: 安装前：受训、认气、固定、取瓶帽
shots.scene: 王老师培训，学员穿实验服戴护目镜手套
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator trains the female graduate student, who wears a lab coat, safety goggles and gloves, beside a cylinder.
shots.narration: 装拆减压阀，先培训，戴好防护。
overlay: 安装前：受训、认气、固定、取瓶帽

shots.section_title: 安装前：受训、认气、固定、取瓶帽
shots.scene: 不会装请专业人员来
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student calling the facility engineer, who arrives with a tool bag. No text.
shots.narration: 不会装，请供气单位或老李来。

shots.section_title: 安装前：受训、认气、固定、取瓶帽
shots.scene: 查SDS弄清气体危害
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a safety data sheet beside a cylinder with flame, skull and oxygen shortage icons. No text.
shots.narration: 先弄清这是什么气，有什么危害。

shots.section_title: 安装前：受训、认气、固定、取瓶帽
shots.scene: 先固定气瓶，再取瓶帽
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: step icons, a chain fastened around a cylinder, then the cap removed with a cap hook. No text.
shots.narration: 先固定气瓶，再取瓶帽，不硬撬。

shots.section_title: 装前检查：瓶阀关严，螺纹和表完好
shots.scene: 听有无嘶嘶声，看有无气雾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an ear icon and an eye icon near a closed cylinder valve, no mist visible. No text.
shots.narration: 听有没有嘶嘶声，看有没有气雾。
overlay: 装前检查：瓶阀关严，螺纹和表完好

shots.section_title: 装前检查：瓶阀关严，螺纹和表完好
shots.scene: 凑近瓶阀去闻打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person putting a nose close to a cylinder valve outlet, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 确认瓶阀关好，别凑近去闻。

shots.section_title: 装前检查：瓶阀关严，螺纹和表完好
shots.scene: 【实拍】检查减压阀接头螺纹和外观（关阀、无压）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands turning a regulator to inspect the inlet nut threads and the body for damage, oil and dust.
shots.narration: 螺纹有损伤、油污、灰尘，不能装。

shots.section_title: 装前检查：瓶阀关严，螺纹和表完好
shots.scene: 压力表裂纹、指针异常打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gauge with a cracked glass and a needle stuck off zero, crossed out with a tag. No text.
shots.narration: 表坏、指针异常，挂牌停用。

shots.section_title: 先关出口阀，调压手轮松到底
shots.scene: 【实拍】顺时针关闭减压阀出口阀（无压）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: fingers turning the small outlet valve of a regulator clockwise until closed.
shots.narration: 先把出口阀关上。
overlay: 先关出口阀，调压手轮松到底

shots.section_title: 先关出口阀，调压手轮松到底
shots.scene: 【实拍】调压手轮逆时针松到底（无压）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand turning the large adjusting knob of a regulator counterclockwise until it turns freely.
shots.narration: 再把调压手轮逆时针松到底。

shots.section_title: 先关出口阀，调压手轮松到底
shots.scene: 松到底，开瓶时气不会冲出
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a regulator with a released spring, gas held back at the seat when the cylinder valve opens. No text.
shots.narration: 开瓶时，气不会一下子冲出来。

shots.section_title: 人站侧面，先手拧，再用扳手
shots.scene: 人站在侧面，不正对出口
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person standing to the side of the cylinder valve and regulator, a person in front of the outlet crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 人站侧面，不正对阀门出口。
overlay: 人站侧面，先手拧，再用扳手

shots.section_title: 人站侧面，先手拧，再用扳手
shots.scene: 【实拍】对准接口，用手把螺母拧到手紧（关阀）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands aligning a regulator inlet nut with a cylinder valve outlet and turning it by hand until snug.
shots.narration: 对准接口，先用手拧到手紧。

shots.section_title: 人站侧面，先手拧，再用扳手
shots.scene: 可燃气体逆时针拧，其他顺时针
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two fittings, one with a counterclockwise arrow and a flame icon, one with a clockwise arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 可燃气体多反扣，先认准再拧。

shots.section_title: 人站侧面，先手拧，再用扳手
shots.scene: 【实拍】用合适的开口扳手拧牢，不过头（关阀）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: an open end wrench tightening the regulator nut a short turn.
shots.narration: 再用合适的扳手拧牢，别拧过头。

shots.section_title: 人站侧面，先手拧，再用扳手
shots.scene: 钳子拧螺母打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: pliers gripping and damaging a brass regulator nut, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不用钳子，铜螺母容易拧坏。

shots.section_title: 人站侧面，先手拧，再用扳手
shots.scene: 可燃、氧化性气体用防爆工具
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a non sparking brass coloured wrench beside a flammable gas cylinder, a sparking steel tool crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 可燃和氧化性气体，用防爆工具。

shots.section_title: 接口不随意缠生料带
shots.scene: 接口缠生料带打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: thread sealing tape being wrapped on a cylinder valve outlet, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 瓶阀接口，不随意缠生料带。

shots.section_title: 接口不随意缠生料带
shots.scene: 密封面和密封垫完好
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clean sealing face and an intact sealing washer with ticks, a torn washer crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 靠接口本身密封，密封垫要完好。

shots.section_title: 接口不随意缠生料带
shots.scene: 要用密封材料先问供应商
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student phoning a supplier while holding a blank instruction leaflet. No text.
shots.narration: 想用密封带，先问厂家或供应商。

shots.section_title: 氧气禁油：表、阀、管路一律无油
shots.scene: 氧气减压阀、阀门、管路上的油污打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an oxygen regulator, valve and tubing with oil drops on them, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 氧气的表、阀、管路，严禁油脂。
overlay: 氧气禁油：表、阀、管路一律无油

shots.section_title: 氧气禁油：表、阀、管路一律无油
shots.scene: 高压氧遇油剧烈燃烧
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: high pressure oxygen meeting a drop of grease and bursting into a fierce flame. No text.
shots.narration: 高压氧遇油，可能燃烧爆炸。

shots.section_title: 氧气禁油：表、阀、管路一律无油
shots.scene: 沾油的手和手套不碰氧气设备
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an oily glove and hand reaching for an oxygen valve, crossed out, clean gloves with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 手和手套有油污，不碰氧气设备。

shots.section_title: 氧气禁油：表、阀、管路一律无油
shots.scene: 高压氧猛冲进阀门，压缩发热
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: oxygen rushing into a closed valve chamber, a heat glow at the end, warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 高压氧猛冲进来，会压缩发热。

shots.section_title: 氧气禁油：表、阀、管路一律无油
shots.scene: 慢慢一点点开氧气阀
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand turning an oxygen valve very slowly with small arrow steps. No text.
shots.narration: 所以开氧气阀要慢，一点点开。

shots.section_title: 氧气禁油：表、阀、管路一律无油
shots.scene: 氧气专用零件清洁密封包装
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an oxygen clean fitting sealed in a clean bag, opened only at installation. No text.
shots.narration: 只用氧气专用件，装时再拆包装。

shots.section_title: 用完关闭与拆卸：关阀、泄压、戴帽
shots.scene: 用完先关瓶阀
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: step one icon, a hand closing the cylinder valve clockwise. No text.
shots.narration: 用完先关瓶阀。
overlay: 用完关闭与拆卸：关阀、泄压、戴帽

shots.section_title: 用完关闭与拆卸：关阀、泄压、戴帽
shots.scene: 放尽减压阀里的余气，再关出口阀
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: both gauges falling to zero, then the outlet valve closed. No text.
shots.narration: 放尽表里余气，再关出口阀。

shots.section_title: 用完关闭与拆卸：关阀、泄压、戴帽
shots.scene: 减压阀不带压存放
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a regulator with both gauges at zero on a shelf, a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 减压阀不带压，读数更准更耐用。

shots.section_title: 用完关闭与拆卸：关阀、泄压、戴帽
shots.scene: 【实拍】确认两表归零后，先用扳手松开，再用手旋下（关阀）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: both regulator gauges at zero, a wrench loosening the nut, then fingers unscrewing it.
shots.narration: 确认无压，扳手松开，再手旋下。

shots.section_title: 用完关闭与拆卸：关阀、泄压、戴帽
shots.scene: 拆下后马上戴回瓶帽
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cylinder getting its cap screwed back on right after the regulator is removed. No text.
shots.narration: 拆下马上戴回瓶帽。

shots.section_title: 用完关闭与拆卸：关阀、泄压、戴帽
shots.scene: 带压拆卸接头打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wrench on a fitting while the gauge shows pressure, gas spraying, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 有压力时，不拆不紧接头。

shots.section_title: 卡套接头：管口平整、插到底
shots.scene: 细管、卡套接头、阀门连成气路
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: thin metal tubing joined by compression fittings and small valves forming a gas line to an instrument. No text.
shots.narration: 细管、接头、阀门，连成一条气路。
overlay: 卡套接头：管口平整、插到底

shots.section_title: 卡套接头：管口平整、插到底
shots.scene: 卡套咬紧管子密封剖面
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a compression fitting cross section showing the ferrule gripping the tube. No text.
shots.narration: 卡套接头，靠卡套咬紧管子密封。

shots.section_title: 卡套接头：管口平整、插到底
shots.scene: 【实拍】切平的管口插到接头底部再拧紧（无压）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a cleanly cut tube end pushed fully into a compression fitting body, then the nut tightened.
shots.narration: 管口切平，插到底，再拧紧。

shots.section_title: 卡套接头：管口平整、插到底
shots.scene: 没插到底的接头漏气
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tube not fully inserted in a fitting with gas leaking at the joint, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 没插到底，接头就会漏。

shots.section_title: 卡套接头：管口平整、插到底
shots.scene: 快插气管插到底，轻拉确认
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a plastic air hose pushed into a push in fitting and gently pulled back to test. No text.
shots.narration: 快插气管插到底，轻拉拉不出才算好。

shots.section_title: 卡套接头：管口平整、插到底
shots.scene: 不同来源的零件混装打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fitting made from mixed parts of unknown origin, crossed out, a matched certified set with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 同一接头用同一套合格部件。

shots.section_title: 卡套接头：管口平整、插到底
shots.scene: 正规渠道采购，来路不明不装
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: parts arriving from a licensed supplier with a certificate, unknown parts in a box crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 正规渠道采购，来路不明不装。

shots.section_title: 气体管路：标明介质流向，定期检查
shots.scene: 【实拍】墙上气体管路的介质和流向标识
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: gas lines on a lab wall with coloured labels and flow direction arrows.
shots.narration: 管路标明气体名称和流向。
overlay: 气体管路：标明介质流向，定期检查

shots.section_title: 气体管路：标明介质流向，定期检查
shots.scene: 易燃有毒气体管路按规定安装
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the facility engineer installing a flammable gas line with a rule book icon nearby. No text.
shots.narration: 易燃有毒管路，按国标和校规装。

shots.section_title: 气体管路：标明介质流向，定期检查
shots.scene: 私自改接管路打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student cutting and rejoining a gas line by himself, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 专业人员安装，不私自改接。

shots.section_title: 气体管路：标明介质流向，定期检查
shots.scene: 定期检查管路，坏了就换
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person inspecting a gas line with a checklist, a cracked hose being replaced. No text.
shots.narration: 定期检查管路，有损坏立即换。

shots.section_title: 气体管路：标明介质流向，定期检查
shots.scene: 开机前查接头和压力
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person checking hose joints and a pressure gauge before switching on a machine. No text.
shots.narration: 开机前查接头，压力不超限。

shots.section_title: 气体管路：标明介质流向，定期检查
shots.scene: 换完接头先检漏
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a brush applying leak test solution to a new joint, no bubbles, a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 换件之后，先检漏再用。

shots.section_title: 高压阀门：按额定压力，不凑合
shots.scene: 汇流排上的高压阀门和接头
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gas manifold with high pressure valves and fittings connecting several cylinders. No text.
shots.narration: 高压气路，用高压专用阀和管件。
overlay: 高压阀门：按额定压力，不凑合

shots.section_title: 高压阀门：按额定压力，不凑合
shots.scene: 普通管件凑合用打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an ordinary plumbing fitting installed in a high pressure line, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不能拿普通阀门、管件凑合。

shots.section_title: 高压阀门：按额定压力，不凑合
shots.scene: 阀门铭牌上的额定压力
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a valve with a blank nameplate highlighted and a gauge icon, an over pressure arrow crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 按铭牌额定压力用，不能超压。

shots.section_title: 高压阀门：按额定压力，不凑合
shots.scene: 同一阀门用于氧气时允许压力更低
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one valve with two pressure bars, a lower bar marked with an oxygen icon. No text.
shots.narration: 用于氧气，允许压力更低。

shots.section_title: 高压阀门：按额定压力，不凑合
shots.scene: 转不动不用加力杆和锤子
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a stuck valve handle with a cheater bar and a hammer crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 手柄转不动就停，不加力、不敲。

shots.section_title: 背压阀、安全阀不堵不乱调
shots.scene: 安全阀排气管引到排风处
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a relief valve vent line routed into an exhaust duct, away from people. No text.
shots.narration: 可燃有毒气体，排放引到排风处。
overlay: 背压阀、安全阀不堵不乱调

shots.section_title: 背压阀、安全阀不堵不乱调
shots.scene: 堵排放口、调高设定打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cap plugging a relief vent and a hand turning up a setting screw, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不堵排放口，不随意调高设定。

shots.section_title: 背压阀、安全阀不堵不乱调
shots.scene: 进口过滤网先泄压再清洁
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gauge at zero, then an inlet filter screen removed and cleaned. No text.
shots.narration: 过滤网定期清洁，先泄压再拆。

shots.section_title: 可燃气体管路装阻火器
shots.scene: 可燃气体管路上的阻火器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flame arrester on a flammable gas line between the regulator and the burner. No text.
shots.narration: 可燃气体管路，常装阻火器。
overlay: 可燃气体管路装阻火器

shots.section_title: 可燃气体管路装阻火器
shots.scene: 火焰被阻火器挡住
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flame travelling back along a line and being stopped at the flame arrester. No text.
shots.narration: 挡住回火，不让火窜进气瓶。

shots.section_title: 可燃气体管路装阻火器
shots.scene: 检查阻火器，回火后确认完好
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the facility engineer inspecting a flame arrester with a checklist after a flashback icon. No text.
shots.narration: 定期检查，回火后查过再用。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 专用减压阀、不用转接头图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, a matched regulator with a tick and an adapter crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 表阀专用，接不上不硬接。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 关出口阀、松手轮、站侧面、手拧再扳手
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four step icons, an outlet valve closed, a knob loosened, a person to the side and a hand then a wrench. No text.
shots.narration: 关出口、松手轮，站侧面，先手拧。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 氧气禁油、带压不拆、管路标识
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, an oil drop crossed out on an oxygen valve, a pressure gauge with a no wrench symbol and a labelled pipe. No text.
shots.narration: 氧气禁油，带压不拆，管路标清。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣拿着检漏液刷子挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a small brush and a bottle of leak test solution and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：调压、检漏与泄漏处置。
